title: Broke at 30: money mistakes nobody warned you about
description: Review money habits, buffers, and trade-offs that can shape career choices in your thirties without treating one budget as universal.

Review money habits, buffers, and trade-offs that can shape career choices in your thirties without treating one budget as universal.

The bank balance nobody sees

A thirty-year-old can look successful on paper and still calculate every payment before the month ends. A salary increase may have arrived alongside rent, family support, education debt, insurance, a vehicle, and obligations that are not visible on social media. “Broke” is a description of liquidity, not a moral diagnosis. Family transfers are a budget line

In many Indian households, supporting parents, siblings, or a medical need is not an optional lifestyle choice. It may also be irregular, which makes it easy to underestimate.
